movelist.name: Whirlwind
movelist.effect: All targets are pushed X meters, where X is 8 minus their weight class. If the Line targets into a Smokescreen, the smoke is dispersed. All hazards in the Whirlwind are destroyed.

movelist.name: Tailwind
movelist.effect: For the remainder of the encounter, all allied trainers and Pokémon gain +5 to their Initiative. Multiple instances of Tailwind cannot stack.

movelist.name: Roost
movelist.effect: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Points. If the user is a Flying Type, it loses the Flying Type until the start of their next turn.

movelist.name: Air Cutter
movelist.effect: Air Cutter is a Critical Hit on 18+.

movelist.name: Agility
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Speed 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Frisk
abilities.effect: The user gains a +2 Bonus to all Accuracy Rolls against adjacent targets.

abilities.name: Sound Lance
abilities.effect: Connection – Supersonic. The target of Supersonic loses Hit Points equal to the user’s Special Attack. This occurs even if Supersonic misses.

abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.effect: The user may activate this Ability to use a Move with a Damage Base of 6 (before applying STAB or other modifiers) or lower as if it had the Priority keyword. If it hits, the target is Flinched and has a -2 penalty to Accuracy Rolls for 1 full round.
